info.body_text:
As you're walking down the street, nothing comes to mind. You are completely and utterly lost. Though there are some pretty storefronts along the side of this street.

You should find some way of making money.
Perhaps check out this cute cafe

Go further down the street
Go further up the street

Just enjoy the scenery and walk along
